items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: when I moved to Vegas to join Harry James

ctx.x: Did you miss out on some of their things that you wanted to get to or had you settled in one place by that time?

Well I didn’t have the children — after I got out of the service I moved to New York and we didn’t have any children at that point. And then when I moved to Vegas to join Harry James we didn’t have any children yet. And when we had our first child, my daughter, I did about six months with that — and that’s when I told Stan — I mean Harry — I said, “This is too hard, I don’t think I can do this anymore.” However, we used to work 50 weeks a year and we were mostly in Nevada: Reno, Tahoe, Vegas. Reno, Tahoe, Vegas.…
And you’re going to replace the gig with Harry James with what?
